title: Music
myListsEmptyTitle: No lists of your own yet
myListsEmptyDescription: Collected songs and lists you create appear here; songlists and charts need a music source first.
libraryEmptyTitle: The song library is on its way
libraryEmptyDescription: Once a music source lands, songs will page in here as a masonry grid of cards.
playlistsEmptyDescription: Playlists you curate and follow will live here.
chartsEmptyDescription: Popular-song charts from the music sources will live here.
sourceNameTypeDesc: How the platforms are worded in the lists: aliases are the reference's stage names, real names are the platforms' own.
openPlaylistTip: Links or IDs from the current source only; what you paste is parsed into a playlist ID before it opens.
duplicateListTip: You collected "{name}" before. Pull the latest and overwrite its tracks?
onlineUpdateFailed: The update failed; try again later.
songlistSearchUnsupported: This source cannot search songlists yet.
defaultSourceDesc: The source a song is asked from; lx-music resolves play URLs through the imported custom-source scripts.
defaultSourceEmpty: No source yet — import a script under Custom sources below.
qualityDesc: The rendition asked of a source; a source that lacks it answers with the best it has.
skipOnErrorDesc: Moves to the next source when one cannot answer, instead of stopping.
autoplayDesc: Continues the last queue when the music module opens.
rememberProgressDesc: A song you open again resumes where it last stopped.
addToTopDesc: Off keeps them at the end of a list.
showSourceDesc: Marks which source a song came from beside its row.
playbackResetDesc: Automatic source, 320K, skip failures, new songs at the end.
sourcesHint: lx-music custom sources are JavaScript scripts run by the fjs (QuickJS) runtime; importing initializes them and hands play-URL resolution to them.
sourcesImportTextDesc: Paste the full text of an lx-music custom-source script.
sourcesImportUrlDesc: Downloads the .js at an address and imports it.
importMissing: Paste a script or fill in a link first.
importNotASource: This is not an lx-music source: the text has no @name header comment, or never touches the lx API.
importLimit: At most {count} custom sources; remove one first.
sourcesEmptyDesc: Import an lx-music custom-source script and it appears here.
sourceDeleteDesc: Its script is deleted too; importing it again restores it.
sourcesReloadDesc: Initialize every imported lx script again.
searchIdleDescription: Type a title, an artist or an album and press enter.
mineEmptyDescription: Songs you collect or play appear here.
lyricsEmpty: This song has no lyrics yet.
disliked: Added to the dislike rules; it will be skipped
dislikeRulesDesc: Songs with a rule are skipped when the queue reaches them.
searchHotDesc: Show the source's top searches while the search page is empty.
searchHotFailed: Could not load the top searches
playlistDeleteDesc: The playlist is removed; its songs are not deleted.
playlistEmptyDescription: Add songs from a row’s “More actions” menu.
playlistImportInvalid: The file has no usable songs
downloadDuplicate: This song is already in the download queue
downloadUnsupported: This song has no downloadable source (a local file, or not covered by the current source)
downloadHint: Files land in the shared download folder; the queue supports pause, resume and retry.
downloadDirectoryDefaultDesc: Return to the app’s default downloads folder.
downloadTypeDesc: Original keeps the source container; transcoding needs ffmpeg.
downloadPatternHint: Placeholders (written inside braces): title, artist, album, quality, source, list, index.
downloadEmbedCoverDesc: Write the cover into the audio tags.
downloadEmbedLyricDesc: Write the lyric into the audio tags so it travels with the file.
downloadIncludeTranslationDesc: Write the translation into the downloaded lyric file and embedded tag.
downloadIncludeRomanizationDesc: Write the romanization into the downloaded lyric file and embedded tag.
downloadWriteLyricDesc: Write a sibling .lrc next to the audio file.
downloadSkipExistingDesc: Do not download when the output file is already there.
downloadGroupByListDesc: When downloading from a playlist, save into a folder named after it.
downloadMaxConcurrentDesc: How many downloads run at once (1–5); changes apply immediately.
downloadsEmptyDescription: Download from a row’s “More actions” menu; files go to {directory}.
localHint: Add a folder of audio files; the scan makes them play like online songs.
localEmptyDescription: Add a folder of audio files to start scanning.
lyricOffsetDesc: Positive values show the lyric later.
lyricTranslationDesc: Show the translation when the lyric has one.
lyricRomanizationDesc: Show the romanization when the lyric has one.
lyricSwapSecondaryDesc: Swap translation and romanization under a lyric line.
lyricTraditionalizeDesc: Rewrite lyric text into traditional Chinese.
lyricWordTimedDesc: Play karaoke-style word timing when the platform provides it.
lyricFontScaleDesc: Scale of the lyrics in the player (100%–200%).
lyricAlignmentDesc: How lyric lines sit inside the player panel.
lyricZoomActiveDesc: Draw the line being sung a little larger.
lyricProgressDesc: Show the song's progress above the lyric panel.
lyricHint: The display and delay apply to every song; desktop lyrics open from Settings or the player’s More actions menu.
desktopLyricsUnavailable: This platform has no desktop lyric window, or the permission was refused
desktopLyricHint: Desktop lyrics are a floating window you can drag, lock and control; Android needs the overlay permission.
desktopLyricEnableDesc: Float the current lyric over the desktop; turning it off keeps the style below.
desktopLyricLockDesc: A locked window lets clicks pass through to the app underneath.
desktopLyricOpacityDesc: The opacity of the whole overlay window.
desktopLyricStrokeColorDesc: The text outline’s colour; unused when the outline width is 0.
desktopLyricStrokeWidthDesc: How thick the text outline is; 0 turns it off.
desktopLyricAlignmentDesc: How the line is anchored in the window.
associateLyricFailed: Could not link: the file has no usable lyric
eqEnabledDesc: Off means the audio runs untouched, whatever the bands say.
eqPresetDesc: A target character, not a promise for every headphone or speaker.
eqPreampDesc: Applied before the bands; lower it when the curve clips.
hkEnableDesc: In-app accelerators for the transport and volume.
hkPressNew: Press a new combination, Esc cancels
hkNote: Only works inside the app window; system-wide (global) registration needs platform support that has not landed.
eqResetDesc: Every band and the preamp back to zero.
eqHint: Drag a handle to shape its band; the curve updates as you drag and reaches the player in real time.
eqChainNote: The predicted curve is a theory-layer preview; the actual audio follows the FFmpeg chain derived from these values.
eqApplyFailed: The engine refused this effect chain — the sound runs unprocessed. Turn effects off and try a smaller chain.
eqFxLoudnessDesc: loudnorm holds loudness steady across tracks and sources.
eqFxBassDesc: bass low shelf under 105 Hz, up to +8 dB.
eqFxVocalDesc: presence lift at 3 kHz with a mud cut at 300 Hz.
eqFxWidthDesc: stereotools raises the side level, keeping the centre intact.
eqFxSurroundDesc: haas pseudo-surround from a small cross delay.
eqFxDynamicsDesc: acompressor evens the peaks, alimiter guards the output.
eqAnalysisDesc: Runs an EBU R128 probe in the chain; playback is untouched
eqMeterNote: Loudness level meter (M = 400 ms momentary, S = 3 s short-term), not an FFT spectrum — mpv exposes no raw spectrum.
eqCompareHeld: Playing the original — release to restore
onlineUnsupported: The current source does not serve online playlists
syncHostHint: lx-music sync server address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:23332
syncAuthCodeHint: The connection code shown by the server
syncStatusHint: Connect to pull the server's lists and push local changes back.
syncForgetKeyDesc: Drop the stored key and re-auth with the code next time.
syncNote: Lists sync with a lx-music desktop server: recent, favourites and your playlists. The server merges using the chosen mode.
catalogHint: Sources from the pdone/lx-music-source community collection; importing downloads the latest script over the GitHub-acceleration setting.
catalogFetchFailed: Downloading the source script failed: every mirror was unreachable
